citations.title: Microsoft FY 2026 Fourth Quarter Earnings Conference Call

citations.title: The Crypto Cycle and US Monetary Policy
citations.author: Natasha Che; Alexander Copestake; Davide Furceri; Tammaro Terracciano

citations.title: 26 U.S.C. § 197 — Amortization of goodwill and certain other intangibles

citations.scope: 美国联邦所得税的一般无形资产规则；具体交易需专业税务分析。

citations.title: American Jobs Creation Act of 2004, H.R. 4520

citations.scope: 2004年联邦立法变更及其一般法律背景。
